newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian companies' profits rise in Q2.
newsitem.headline: Estonian companies' profits rise in Q2.

text.p: Estonian companies' second quarter net turnover rose 41 percent to 33 billion kroons versus the same period last year and pre-tax profits increased 48 percent to 967 million kroons, the statistics office said on Tuesday.

The rise in profits and turnover outstripped inflation, which the office said was a year-on-year 27 percent in the second quarter. The statistics do not include agricultural producers, the finance industry or insurance firms.
The office said profit growth was the greatest in the building sector while the largest fall was in the timber industry.
